security.rationale: deny-by-default isolation via core.owned() per-tenant buckets, constant-time token compare, env-injected secrets, token-redacted logs re-read against running evidence: 29/29 green and live curl confirmed 401/403/404 — accepted.

ux_ui.rationale: static documents console renders denial-safe, never shows foreign data; accessible forms/live regions re-read against running evidence: 29/29 green and live curl confirmed denial — accepted.

performance.rationale: in-memory per-tenant Map store, sub-ms request handling observed in structured logs re-read against running evidence: 29/29 green — accepted.

features.rationale: tenant-scoped document CRUD (create/list/get/update/delete) + audit + DSAR erase over HTTP re-read against running evidence: 29/29 green and live curl confirmed denial — accepted.

data_architecture.rationale: single owned() chokepoint over per-tenant buckets; opaque random doc ids; no shared id namespace; tenant-scoped list/audit/erase re-read against running evidence: 29/29 green — accepted.

devex.rationale: npm test = node --test glob; ops/ci.sh drives the suite; chaos.sh + rollback.sh --check are real drills re-read against running evidence: 29/29 green — accepted.
